# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes. Please update before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Common-Fool/WindGets/security/advisories/new)
(Security → Report a vulnerability).

Include the Windgets version, what you did, what happened and, if you can,
the steps to reproduce it. You will get an answer within a week.

Windgets runs with administrator rights, downloads tools from their official
GitHub releases and keeps mail and 2FA secrets on disk, so reports about any
of these are especially welcome.
